note-format (decide the file format for notes) is a Decide sub-goal. I wrote the comparison in `chosen-test/docs/note-format.md`. The question tool is not available here, so I am asking in chat.

Which format for the notes?
- A (Recommended): Markdown. Readable as plain text, renders on GitHub; no structure for metadata.
- B: Plain text. Simplest; no headings or links.
- C: JSON. Structured; hard to write by hand.

Please also tell me why you chose it.
